blocks.title: Oscillatory motion (aage peeche jhoolna)
blocks.text: Oscillatory motion kisi cheez ki apni mean position (darmiyani jagah) ke gird aage peeche ki motion (harkat) hai. Yeh periodic motion hai, yani barabar waqt ke baad khud ko dohrati hai.
Rozmarra zindagi mein oscillatory motion ki bohat si misalein milti hain. Kuch yeh hain:

blocks.alt: Kitab ki tarah: vertical spring par latka mass m, us ka weight mg neeche; deewar se bandhe horizontal spring par mass m, x tak khincha hua, restoring force (wapas lane wali quwwat) F = -kx deewar ki taraf; stand par S se latka simple pendulum jo mean position A ke gird B aur C ke darmiyan jhoolta hai; tuning fork jis ki dono shaakhein aage peeche thartharati hain; A-frame se latke narangi jhoolay par hansta hua bachcha.
blocks.caption: Oscillatory motion ki misalein: vertical spring par mass, horizontal spring par mass, simple pendulum, tuning fork aur jhoolay par bachcha (kitab ki be-number tasveeron ke mutabiq original drawing).

items: Simple pendulum, jab use us ki rest ki jagah se hata kar chhora jaye, apni mean position ke gird jhoolta hai.
Spring ke sire par laga mass, jab use kheench kar chhora jaye, horizontal ya vertical plane (satah) mein aage peeche jhoolta hai.
Solid (thos cheez) ke atoms ya molecules apni mean position ke gird jhoolte hain.
Jab awaz ki lehrein hawa se guzarti hain to hawa ke molecules aage peeche jhoolte hain.
Guitar aur violin jaise aksar musical instruments (saaz) mein strings (taarein) hoti hain jo thartharaa kar music paida karti hain.

blocks.alt: Do tasveerein saath saath. Baen: narangi acoustic guitar bajate haath, ek haath sound hole ke oopar taar chherta aur doosra frets par taar dabata hai. Daen: halke neele-grey aasman mein par phailaye urta baaz (falcon).
blocks.caption: Guitar ke taar aur urte parinde ke par (misal (vii) aur (viii) ke saath chhapi tasveeron ke mutabiq original drawing)

blocks.text: Jo bhi cheez thartharati ya jhoolti hai us ki ek equilibrium position (tawazun ki jagah), yani mean position, hoti hai. Jab cheez ko is jagah se hataya jaye to ek restoring force use wapas isi jagah ki taraf laati hai; isi se cheez thartharati (vibrate) ya jhoolti (oscillate) hai.
